title: Your Privacy and Safety

principles.title: We ask only what we need
principles.description: NariCare collects only information needed to provide general health-navigation guidance.

does: Help users prepare for healthcare conversations
Respond in the user's preferred language
does_not: Store health data persistently in this prototype
Require Aadhaar, address, or sensitive identification

accessibility_commitment.title: Accessibility Commitment
accessibility_commitment.description: NariCare is designed from the beginning for blind, deaf or hard-of-hearing, and non-disabled users. The AI adapts its communication style, not just its content, based on accessibility preferences.

prototype_disclosure.title: Prototype Disclosure
prototype_disclosure.description: This is a PartyRock prototype demonstrating NariCare's AI-powered health navigation engine. A production system would integrate secure authentication, persistent user profiles, and appropriate healthcare privacy compliance.
